speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
text: asked	the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth whether the Ministry will consider encouraging major tourist attractions to charge special rates for multi-generational Singaporean visitors to promote intergenerational bonding.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: For places of interest and facilities under the the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) family, we encourage multigenerational visitors through family-oriented programming.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: Their exhibitions particularly lend themselves to intergenerational bonding.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: There are many other platforms to encourage intergenerational family bonding.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: These include a wide range of regular community events and free-access public spaces such as the Marina Barrage and popular parks such as Singapore Botanic Gardens and East Coast Park.
